datasheet_identity.title: SS52F THRU SS520F SURFACE MOUNT SCHOTTKY BARRIER RECTIFIER

extraction_notes: Maximum repetitive peak reverse voltage VRRM is 40 V for SS54F and maximum average forward rectified current IF(AV) is 5.0 A at TA = 25 degC, p. 1.
The 100 degC reverse-current row is 50 mA at VR = VDC = 40 V for SS54F; the required reverse_current field records the separate 25 degC maximum row.
Typical junction capacitance is 500 pF at 4.0 V DC and 1 MHz for the SS52F-SS54F group, which includes SS54F.
The datasheet publishes no reverse-recovery-time or breakdown-voltage value.

Curve points are manual reads from the supplied family-group plots. The forward plot groups SS52F-SS54F, and the 25 degC reverse plot groups SS52F-SS56F; the plotted group membership is preserved in each curve name and test_conditions.
extraction.omission_reason: No reverse-recovery or breakdown specification is published. The available curves are grouped typical plots rather than an SS54F-only trace, but SS54F is explicitly included in the plotted curve groups.
